title: Search Of Suspected Communists Headquarters

page_data.en:
1.0. 7815
Shanghai Municipal Police. （印：整）
Intelligence Office, C. I. D. Station.
April 23, 1927.
REPORT ON Search of suspected Communists headquarters.
Made by D. I. Yorke. Forwarded by [签名] C.S.I.
Sir,
I beg to report that, at 6.30 p.m. on April 23,
a party of Police and detectives, accompanied by one, Dzien Tuh
Sung(徐德勝), officer-in-charge of the Investigation
Department of the 26th Nationalist Army Headquarters, searched
premises, Nos. 468/9 Chapoo Road, for communist propaganda.
These premises, though having a common front entrance, are
divided on the ground floor, half being occupied by the Luen Hop
Co.(联益社), a concern engaged in ship chandling, and half
being used as a Seamen's club under the name of Lien Nyi(联义社).
This club is not licensed and is used exclusively by the Cantonese
crews of trans-Pacific steamers.
One of the signatures to the attached letter
addressed to Waung Shou Hwa(汪寿華), the Chairman of the
General Labour Union, Liang Shih Ching(梁日清) is a partner in
the ship's chandler concern "Luen Hop Co." but he was not present
when the premises were searched and is said to have gone to
Canton. The other two persons whose names appear on the
attached letter, i.e. Chen Yung(陳雄) and Ho Yih Chien(何翼劍),
could not be identified with either the Luen Hop Co. or the
Lien Nyi Club.
During a thorough search of these premises,
a quantity of anti-Sun Chuan Fang pamphlets, a number of books
containing extreme radical views were seen, but nothing of a
really Communistic nature was discovered.
The official from the 26th Nationalist Army Headquarters stated
that, in the absence of the three persons whose names are

刑事调查处情报股。
1927年4月23日。
关于搜查疑似共产党总部的报告。
由 D. I. Yorke 撰写。由 [签名] C.S.I. 转呈。
阁下，
谨此报告，4月23日下午6时30分，一队警员及侦探在国民革命军第二十六军总部调查处处长徐德勝（Dzien Tuh Sung）一名官员的陪同下，搜查了乍浦路468/9号的处所，以查缴共产主义宣传品。
该处所虽有一个共同的前门入口，但在底楼分为两部分，一半由从事船舶供应业务的联益社（Luen Hop Co.）占用，另一半则作为名为联义社（Lien Nyi）的海员俱乐部使用。该俱乐部未获执照，专供跨太平洋轮船的广东籍船员使用。
附函致总工会主席汪寿華（Waung Shou Hwa），其中一名签署人梁日清（Liang Shih Ching）是船舶供应商行“联益社”的合伙人，但在搜查该处所时他不在场，据称已前往广州。附函上署名的另外两人，即陳雄（Chen Yung）和何翼劍（Ho Yih Chien），无法确认与联益社或联义社俱乐部有任何关联。
在对这些处所进行彻底搜查期间，发现大量反孙传芳传单以及若干包含极端激进观点的书籍，但未发现任何真正具有共产主义性质的物品。
国民革命军第二十六军总部的官员表示，鉴于致汪寿華信中所提及的三人不在场，他认为

it necessary to make any arrests and in view of the fact
that no actually communistic propaganda was found on the
premises, I agreed, and no arrests were made. At the same

20th. April 1927

Sir:
I beg to offer you the attached letter which
was sent by the Red Agency to the leaders of
Chinese Labour Unions. This Red Agency
is established at your district, Shapoo Road.
It will be dangerous for the public safety
in the Settlement, if this Agency is still
allowed to be active. The address of
the Agency is written on the letter 北四川路
同和里 15 号 Please take effective to arrest
the leaders at once

yours truly
J. A. Blaken.
page_data.zh:
1927年4月20日

阁下：
谨呈上由红色机构发送给中国工会领导人的附件信函。该红色机构设立于贵辖区的乍浦路。若允许该机构继续活动，将对租界的公共安全构成危险。该机构的地址写在信函上：北四川路同和里15号。请采取有效措施，立即逮捕领导人。

您真诚的，
J. A. Blaken.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

Translation of the attached Chinese letter.
April 12, 1927.

(Wang) Shuh Hua
& other Comrades.

Gentlemen,
We were informed that a number of loafers
had, at the instigation of the Re-actionary Party,
created trouble (in your Union) and wounded a number
of persons. At the time we intended to proceed to
your Union to offer our consolation, but the interruption
of communication between the Settlement and Chinese
Territory prevented us to do so. We therefore write
this letter instead. We hope that you will encourage
our comrades to persist in the struggle and that you
will also forward us a report of the occurrence to be
transmitted to the Central (Committee).
Be courageous and forward!

Chen Yung (陳雄),
Ho Yih-chien (何翼釗).

P.S.- Yih Chien has decided to return to Hankow
tomorrow afternoon. It is hoped that you will finish
your report before 5 o'clock and send it to comrade
Liang Shih Ching (梁晴), the Lien Nyi Society (聯義社,
Chapoo Road.

V.P. 500 11-26.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
处长办公室。

附件中文信函译文。
1927年4月12日。

(汪) 寿华
及其他同志。

诸位先生，
获悉有一群流氓在反动派的唆使下，
（在贵工会）制造麻烦并打伤多人。当时我们打算前往
贵工会慰问，但因租界与中国地界之间的通讯中断，
未能成行。故此特致此函。希望你们鼓励
我们的同志坚持斗争，并将此事经过写成报告
转送给我们，以便转呈中央（委员会）。
勇敢前进！

陳雄 (Chen Yung),
何翼釗 (Ho Yih-chien).

附言 - 翼釗决定明天下午返回汉口。希望你们在5点前完成
报告，并发送给联义社（聯義社，
乍浦路）的梁晴（Liang Shih Ching）同志。

V.P. 500 11-26.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE.

Translation of a letter from the Political Department of the office of
the Commander-in-Chief of the Nationalist Army.
April 14; 1927.

Captain Barrett,
Commissioner of Police.

Sir,
We beg to state that two anti-revolutionary
factors named Liang Zih-shing (梁日新) and Lieu
Zai-tseu (劉瑞周) are now hiding in the Lien Yih
Zoh Society (聯益社) in the Lien Yih Lee alleyway
(聯益里) in Chapoo Road, Hongkew, and we request
you to detail policeman to co-operate with us in
arresting them, thus to consolidate our official
friendship.

(Sd) Yang Fu
Chen Ch'un.

OK.
（签名）

处长办公室。

国民革命军总司令部政治部来函译文。
1927年4月14日。

Barrett 队长，
警务处处长。

阁下，
谨此声明，两名反革命分子，名为梁日新（Liang Zih-shing）和刘瑞周（Lieu Zai-tseu），现藏匿于虹口乍浦路联益里（Lien Yih Lee alleyway）的联益社（Lien Yih Zoh Society / 聯益社*）内，恳请阁下派遣警员与我们合作逮捕他们，以此巩固我们官方的友谊。

(签名) 杨虎 (Yang Fu)
陈群 (Chen Ch'un).

OK.
（签名）

*注：原文英文拼写为 Lien Yih Zoh Society，括号内中文为“聯益社”，但结合上下文及前文，此处可能指代同一地点的不同名称或OCR/原文混淆，依原文忠实译出。
